mapper.select: SELECT item_id, category, name, description, price, status, reject_reason, sales_count, creator_id, asset_key, asset_url, asset_width, asset_height, placement_type, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'ACTIVE')

SELECT ui.id AS inventory_id, i.item_id, i.category, i.name, i.description, i.price, i.asset_key, i.asset_url, i.asset_width, i.asset_height, i.placement_type, ui.acquired_at FROM user_inventory ui JOIN item i ON i.item_id = ui.item_id WHERE ui.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ui.acquired_at DESC, ui.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_purchase ( user_id, item_id, payment_id, acorn_price, status, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, #{paymentId}, #{acornPrice}, #{status}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO user_inventory ( user_id, item_id, acquired_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{itemId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE item SET sales_count = sales_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE item_id = #{itemId}
